scope: 12 selected archive records only. Reads complete selected payloads in memory for equality/hashes; writes metadata only. No payload exports, runtime pointers, importer, native game calls, codec decoding or playback.
limitations: Declared and physical file lengths are distinct; differences are reported without assuming corruption.
Table spans and basic sequence headers are bounded against both lengths; this does not prove codec, track bytecode, stream, playback or semantic validity.
Name MD5 matches are locators for explicit selected names, not a global archive inventory.
ORIGIN disk names overlap fields overwritten during runtime preparation; this probe follows no runtime pointers.
No package precedence or effective mod override is inferred from duplicate selected entries.
